medium: PNG mockup only; no Swift changes
initialPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high-resolution portrait PNG of a polished native iPhone home screen for Gym&AI, edge to edge, straight-on, crisp readable text. No surrounding phone, hand, desk, explanatory annotations or mockup board. This is a design proposal, not a screenshot of implemented functionality.

References: image 1 provides the calm, photograph-led workout composition and generous spacing; image 2 provides soft silver-gray depth and restrained frosted glass, not its crowded cards, search or invented statistics. Image 3 is our actual logo; reproduce it accurately and small. Image 4 is Pip, our glossy charcoal companion with teal eyes and orbit ring; preserve that character exactly and keep it small.

Create a light cool silver-gray home screen with charcoal SF Pro-style text and #0097B2 accents, airy Apple Human Interface-inspired typography and realistic restrained Liquid Glass controls. Keep body copy highly legible over stable surfaces. The focal content is an elegant workout card featuring an original studio photograph of an adult woman performing a dumbbell biceps curl, muted teal activewear, soft gray background. Photograph at top, clear text below: "Biceps curl", "Dumbbell · 1 set · 8 reps", and a "View plan" action. Nearby readable label "Illustrative workout" qualifies the sample numbers.

Reading order: native 9:41 status bar and safe areas; compact official logo with a glass Settings gear; heading "Ready when you are."; main workout card; a small Pip coaching row reading "Your coach, Pip" and "One rep at a time. You’ve got this."; compact device row "iPhone camera" and "Connect Watch"; a prominent teal rounded "Start workout" button with charcoal text, well separated from the two-item floating translucent tab bar "Today" and "Progress", Today selected. Everything fits comfortably without clipped controls. No fake heart rate, streak, calorie or progress statistics; no purple, lime, busy gradients or decorative rings beyond Pip's actual orbit ring. Prioritize a premium, welcoming, uncluttered fitness app over flashy glass effects.
